_note: Canonical seed for the full-dynamism decree. ONE source both the Python daemon and the TS app kernel read (app hydrates via GET /policy; see boot/policies.ts + boot/charter.ts which currently hardcode these SAME values and become fetch-on-boot). Change only via policy.swap() so the mutation is mirrored into the append-only events sink. Values here mirror app CHARTER_DEFAULTS + CHARTER_SEED at seed time.

laws: Nothing mutates untracked: every module/state/rule change appends a TrackEntry.
Rules are seeded (not deleted) and swappable; every swap is reversible.
Load-bearing state is derived and verified from runtime signals, folded in at event time, mutated at exactly one owner (generalized NO-MONKEY-PATCH).
Secrets (settings.json, users.json, helmdeck.db, tokens) are git-ignored, never committed.
UI changes are screenshot-and-JUDGED, not just confirmed to render.

capability_charter._note: DISTINCT from the instruction charter above. This is the connector sandbox (daemon/charter.py): what user-built code may do. It is a SECURITY boundary, not agent-editable prose. Represented here as a seed module for trackability, but swap authority is human-only: agentMaySwap does NOT gate it; capabilitySwapRequiresHuman does, and defaults true.
